identity.notes: Q2 2026 13F (filed 2026-08-14 by parent Pershing Square Inc.): $19.5B in 15 rows. Q1 2026 13F: $13.7B in 11 positions — Pershing Square runs one of the most concentrated activist books on Wall Street. Famous big bets include the Herbalife short, the FNMA/FMCC preferreds, and a major stake in Fannie Mae bonds. Public letters often precede activist campaigns.
identity.infoText: Founder and CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management (founded 2004). Runs one of the most concentrated activist books on Wall Street — typically 10–15 positions. Known for the Herbalife short (eventually closed at a loss), the FNMA/FMCC preferreds bet, and ahead-of-the-news public letters. Since Q2 2026 the 13F is filed by the public parent, Pershing Square Inc. (NYSE: PS), which consolidates the fund’s book with the parent’s own direct holdings.
